vr1102a.title: Sony MZ-R910 Type-R MD Walkman Portable MiniDisc Recorder Silver MDLP
vr1102a.packing: Carefully packed with protective cushioning and shipped from Japan with tracking.
vr1102a.details: Sony MZ-R910 Type-R MD Walkman portable MiniDisc recorder in silver, with MDLP and G-Protection. Condition: there is one very small scratch (about 1 mm) on the back and otherwise no noticeable signs of use. The pickup was precisely cleaned and the flexible cable for the recording head was replaced with a new one. Operation was checked with a gum-type battery: playback, stop, track skip, fast forward and rewind work, the disc is read quickly without skipping, and recording from LINE IN and MIC IN was tested, with the recorded content played back and edited without problems. There is no battery leakage mark and the battery terminals are clean. The unit also has a 3.5 mm headphone jack. Included: the recorder only, as shown in the photos. No battery, battery case, remote control, earphones or AC adapter is included. Please see the photos for the exact condition.
vr1102a.why: A used Sony MZ-R910 Type-R MD Walkman portable MiniDisc recorder in silver, unit only.
vr1102a.perfect: MiniDisc fans and recording hobbyists who want a working MD Walkman that can also record.
vr1102a.exp: A pre-owned Sony MZ-R910 MiniDisc recorder with the very small scratch and the service work described above, unit only.
